response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, extensive exposure to cloud platforms (AWS), and relevant work with agentic workflows and MCP — aligning well with key requirements. However, he lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years in production-grade AI systems, vector databases, or RAG architectures, and his AI experience appears adjacent rather than deep. His leadership and mentoring track record is solid but not clearly framed at staff level for GenAI cloud delivery.
strengths: Proven experience with agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Strong cloud infrastructure exposure via AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployments
Demonstrated technical leadership through workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
Limited documentation of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership in GenAI
